title: DACE: Diversity-Driven Adversarial Co-Evolution for Robust LLM Safety Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.22278v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ensuring robust safety alignment of large language models (LLMs) is increasingly difficult as adversarial attacks evolve and outpace alignment pipelines built on pre-collected data. Existing co-evolutionary frameworks let the defender chase a moving attacker, yet their training dynamics expose two compounding pathologies: \emph{attack strategy collapse}, where the attacker overfits to a narrow set of high-reward rewrites, and \emph{defense adversarial forgetting}, where the defender loses competence against earlier attacks as the attack distribution drifts. Existing remedies are partial: attacker-side diversity rewards score textual novelty rather than strategy novelty, and defender-side replay relies on discrete judge scores that ignore estimation uncertainty, response stochasticity, and defender non-stationarity. We introduce \textbf{\method}, a diversity-driven adversarial co-evolution framework that targets both pathologies jointly.

translated_title: DACE：面向鲁棒大语言模型安全对齐的多样性驱动对抗协同进化
translated_abstract: 确保大语言模型（LLM）的鲁棒安全对齐正变得日益困难，因为对抗性攻击不断演化，超越了基于预先收集数据构建的对齐流程。现有的协同进化框架让防御方追赶不断变化的攻击方，但其训练动态暴露出两种相互叠加的病态：攻击策略坍缩，即攻击方过拟合一组狭窄的高奖励改写策略；以及防御方对抗遗忘，即随着攻击分布漂移，防御方丧失了对早期攻击的应对能力。现有的补救措施都只是部分有效的：攻击方侧的多样性奖励衡量的是文本新颖性而非策略新颖性，防御方侧的回放机制依赖于离散的评判分数，忽略了估计不确定性、响应随机性以及防御方的非平稳性。我们提出了DACE，一个多样性驱动的对抗协同进化框架，能够同时针对这两种病态。
tldr: 提出多样性驱动的对抗协同进化框架DACE，通过同时解决攻击策略坍缩与防御方对抗遗忘两大问题，实现更鲁棒的大语言模型安全对齐。
en_tdlr: Proposes DACE, a diversity-driven adversarial co-evolution framework that jointly addresses attack strategy collapse and defense adversarial forgetting to achieve robust LLM safety alignment.
